subject: The video game's environment destruction model; game state only.

main.change_subject: construction: initialize complete group mass on main (#235)
main.fix: Supply complete occupied mass, inertia and COM at parent spawn; disable automatic child aggregation for those properties. Fresh single/multiple fragments and rotated, translated split children are checked before preparation; existing occupied-property checks cover preparation.

method: Shared local Mac, load sampled beside every ram every fifteen seconds, queue time included. Headless, unattended, muted, one capture or build/test job at a time under the machine lock. Diagnostic instruments are deleted. Candidate timings are of rejected code, not the retained tip. No new sweep implementation is retained.

diagnosis.iteration: Pinned Parry nonlinear casts repeatedly query closest points through GJK and bisect time using support points; convex-polyhedron support scans its vertices. A hit also queries contact for the witness normal. Iteration counts were not instrumented.
diagnosis.scope: The three diagnostic runs are independently instrumented observations, not paired prices; do not sum components measured in different runs. Cast wall times sum across bodies that may run in parallel.
